_comment: Per-machine training backends (copy to backends.json; gitignored).
Shallow-merged over the built-in defaults in pipeline/backends.py — you only
need to set keys that differ on THIS machine. Adding a trainer is a config
entry here, not a code change.
Resolution of the interpreter (most portable first):
1. "python": absolute path (set this if the env isn't a standard conda env)
3. <envs>/<conda_env>/bin/python derived from the panel's own sys.prefix
Repos are relative to the Recon Studio repo dir unless given as an absolute path.
Param `type`: int | float | str | bool | select (select needs "options").
Mesh extraction is backend-specific: a backend supports it ONLY if it declares
gsplat below intentionally omits it, so the Mesh tab won't offer gsplat.
Real-size (mm): set `marker_defaults` (physical ChArUco board geometry) to enable
the Mesh tab's 提供 marker option. Scaling scripts live in the panel's tools/ and
run in THIS backend's env (needs opencv-contrib-python / open3d / plyfile / scipy).
